verdict.rationale: DeepSeek explicitly documents OpenAI/Anthropic SDK compatibility ('by modifying the configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK... to access the DeepSeek API'), plus native support for OpenAI Responses API format and no-code integration with tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode. This directly matches the story's migration/adapter path requirement. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a smooth migration (community evidence discusses model quality/reliability rather than SDK-compatibility specifics).
